steps: Select Brian Lee in user table
Change Role dropdown from USER to ADMIN

bugs.expected_behavior: Role is updated to ADMIN in backend database and remains ADMIN on subsequent requests.
bugs.actual_behavior: Frontend shows ADMIN badge and success toast, but backend keeps role as USER in SQLite database.

evidence.ui: Role badge shows ADMIN with success toast

bugs.verification_method: Change Brian Lee role to ADMIN -> Observe success toast -> Refresh list -> Verify role reverted to USER.

steps: Click Edit on Brian Lee (User B)
Change name to Brian Lee - Updated

bugs.expected_behavior: User B (Brian Lee) is updated with new info, User A remains untouched.
bugs.actual_behavior: Frontend edit modal sends targetId=101, updating User A (Alice Kim) instead of User B.
bugs.verification_method: Edit Brian Lee -> Click Save -> Verify Alice Kim is mutated to Brian's input.

steps: Change Status filter dropdown to 'Active Only'

bugs.expected_behavior: Search keyword 'brian' is retained and combined in GET /api/users?search=brian&status=ACTIVE.
bugs.actual_behavior: Search input is cleared to empty string and query sent without search parameter.

evidence.dom: Search input value is cleared to empty

bugs.verification_method: Search for brian -> Change status dropdown -> Observe input value becomes empty and search parameter is lost.

steps: Click the Active badge/button to block user

bugs.expected_behavior: User is_active becomes false and badge changes to Inactive/Blocked.
bugs.actual_behavior: Backend boolean inversion bug forces is_active=true, leaving user active in DB and DOM.
bugs.verification_method: Click Block on active user -> Verify response isActive is true -> Verify badge remains Active.

steps: Click 'Reset Link' action button on user row

bugs.expected_behavior: Visual feedback such as toast, loading indicator, or confirmation is displayed.
bugs.actual_behavior: API 200 OK is received but UI produces zero feedback (no toast, no loader, no DOM change).

evidence.dom_diff: Zero DOM mutations before vs after click

bugs.verification_method: Click Reset Link -> Observe 200 OK in Network -> Verify no visual feedback in DOM.
